decision: invariant le; zero in headings and before bare symbols
alternatives_considered: la/las; zero article
supporting_rationale: avoids the prior Spanish-shaped la/las frame and is stable in number
adverse_evidence: French-looking and artificial for every cohort

decision: invariant un
alternatives_considered: un/una; un/le
supporting_rationale: high written recognizability and no gender agreement
adverse_evidence: Romanian and Portuguese gender systems diverge

decision: noun plus -s
alternatives_considered: Italian/Romanian vocalic plurals; invariant noun
supporting_rationale: broad Western written support and explicit marking
adverse_evidence: penalizes Italian Romanian and some Romansh readers

decision: invariant and normally postnominal
alternatives_considered: agreement paradigms
supporting_rationale: reduces morphology and keeps technical stems stable
adverse_evidence: artificial for all standards

decision: invariant es for singular and plural
alternatives_considered: son; est; è; este
supporting_rationale: prevents undeclared alternation and is compact
adverse_evidence: French Italian Romanian forms diverge

decision: one invariant third-person form listed in lexicon
alternatives_considered: full person paradigms
supporting_rationale: technical prose rarely needs person contrasts
adverse_evidence: verb stems need term-by-term review

decision: se plus invariant verb
alternatives_considered: auxiliary passive
supporting_rationale: avoids participle agreement where agent is irrelevant
adverse_evidence: scope can be ambiguous and must be clause-checked

decision: non immediately before predicate
alternatives_considered: no; ne...pas
supporting_rationale: Galician Italian and learned support; fixed scope
adverse_evidence: Spanish Portuguese French Romanian differ

decision: e / o / ma
alternatives_considered: y; et; i; și / ou; o
supporting_rationale: compact learned/western forms
adverse_evidence: connective layer has no universal attractor

decision: invariant que
alternatives_considered: care; che; qui
supporting_rationale: high cross-West transparency
adverse_evidence: Romanian and French penalties; subject/object ambiguity

decision: si P comma in tal caso Q

decision: non solmente X ma etiam Y

supporting_rationale: learned formal pair with explicit scope
adverse_evidence: high-register and not corpus-verified across all cohorts

decision: invariant iste
alternatives_considered: este; cette; questo; acest
supporting_rationale: learned compromise and distinct from article
adverse_evidence: not native-neutral

decision: invariant su
alternatives_considered: son/sa; seu; suo; său
supporting_rationale: compact shared stem
adverse_evidence: number/gender distinctions erased

decision: fixed de in con per a

adverse_evidence: semantic mapping and contractions remain artificial

decision: -tion abstract nouns; -ism map nouns; -ic/-iv/-al adjectives
alternatives_considered: -ción/-zione/-isme families

adverse_evidence: stress and collision review still open

decision: equation-first notation and explicit side label

adverse_evidence: prose side words still needed later

decision: no standard pronunciation promoted
alternatives_considered: phonemic pan-Romance pronunciation
supporting_rationale: written experiment can be tested independently
adverse_evidence: oral comprehension untested

decision: use operand order cm / m tau / tau-star m-star and avoid a promoted left/right lexeme

adverse_evidence: running prose may later require reviewed side words

decision: P implica Q
alternatives_considered: si P in tal caso Q; P => Q
supporting_rationale: compact learned verb while formulas remain visible

decision: le duo actiones
alternatives_considered: ambes actiones; le duas actiones
supporting_rationale: avoids selecting a gendered cardinal while preserving pair scope
adverse_evidence: slightly analytic and artificial

decision: retain the source-facing word plus an editorial non-promotion note
alternatives_considered: silent modernization; silent literal promotion
supporting_rationale: preserves historical evidence without claiming a modern sense
adverse_evidence: readers need the note to avoid false equivalence

decision: place in maniera unic immediately before un classe de representation and explain that bases yield multiple representatives
alternatives_considered: un representation unic; unicmente determina
supporting_rationale: prevents the theorem from asserting one representation per module
adverse_evidence: the short headline can still invite a scope misread

decision: use de M a se mesme rather than sur M or sobre M
alternatives_considered: de M sur se; endomorfism
supporting_rationale: avoids importing a surjectivity meaning while retaining a self-map
adverse_evidence: the analytic phrase is less compact

decision: use se defini and se nomina for source definitions
alternatives_considered: passive morphology; first-person plural
supporting_rationale: stable impersonal construction shared with earlier tranches
adverse_evidence: register remains provisional

decision: name the product as a composed transformation and retain the terminal equality c1c2m
alternatives_considered: reverse functional-composition convention; omit the prose label
supporting_rationale: the source fixes its convention by the displayed action and it must control
adverse_evidence: modern composition notation can use the opposite reading

decision: repeat le matrices e le transformationes where a pronoun could obscure mutual determination
alternatives_considered: illos; celles-ci
supporting_rationale: keeps the bijective correspondence explicit across cohorts
adverse_evidence: repetition is stylistically heavy

decision: retain the ordered basis tuple as a row and place C D and P on its right
alternatives_considered: column-vector transcription; transpose all formulas
supporting_rationale: the source-side convention determines both product and conjugation order
adverse_evidence: row notation is less common in some modern expositions

decision: repeat c with C and d with D before using the additive and multiplicative formulas
alternatives_considered: pronouns only; omit the second pairing
supporting_rationale: prevents case-insensitive or OCR-mediated confusion between ring elements and matrices
adverse_evidence: repetition is stylistically heavy

decision: retain c+d to C+D and cd to CD and repeat that CD is not reversed
alternatives_considered: modern function-composition order with DC; abstract statement without calculation
supporting_rationale: the source supplies an explicit row-vector calculation whose terminal equality controls the map
adverse_evidence: readers trained on left column vectors may expect the opposite order

decision: state y=xP before stating that the new matrix is P^{-1}CP
alternatives_considered: choose x=yP; use PCP^{-1}
supporting_rationale: the two formulas form one direction-locked change-of-basis package
adverse_evidence: either alternative is valid under a different convention and therefore dangerous if mixed

decision: use tote le representationes de un classe de representation and retain the all-bases condition
alternatives_considered: tote le matrices; tote le representationes; omit de un classe
supporting_rationale: the theorem concludes coverage of representatives inside one class only
adverse_evidence: the source headline is compact enough to invite global overreading

decision: explicitly state that the conclusion does not reach every matrix in T_n or every representation class
alternatives_considered: leave the restriction implicit; add it to the translated theorem sentence
supporting_rationale: the editorial note makes the safeguard visible without inserting a new negative clause into the source translation
adverse_evidence: the note is analytic and has no native-reader validation

decision: retain cata classe and repeat that the theorem is limited to direct representations
alternatives_considered: every representation; omit the parenthetical
supporting_rationale: the source quantifies over classes and then narrows the main proof to direct ones
adverse_evidence: compact wording can invite a global all-matrices reading

decision: use the sense-scoped test form demostracio for formal mathematical proof
alternatives_considered: prova; pruva; demonstration
supporting_rationale: the WordWeb separates formal proof from test or trial and the cross-branch medoid candidate is not identical to standard Spanish or French
adverse_evidence: the form remains a hypothesis and has no native validation

decision: encode action side first by operand order x_i tau_i and c times the sum then add analytic side glosses
alternatives_considered: promote a single left/right lexical pair
supporting_rationale: Romance branches split sharply between gauche droite; izquierda derecha; sinistra destra; stânga dreapta
adverse_evidence: analytic glosses are longer than standard-language labels

decision: render dann und nur dann as si e solmente si and retain the bidirectional arrow
alternatives_considered: one-way si; omit the prose phrase
supporting_rationale: the iff condition makes the formal generators coordinate-independent
adverse_evidence: a weak connective would change the construction

decision: reuse lege associativ mixed and display c(m rho)=(cm)rho
alternatives_considered: direct calque of durchlaufend; ordinary associativity
supporting_rationale: the equation concerns compatibility of two actions rather than one multiplication
adverse_evidence: the analytic term is provisional and not native-reviewed

decision: keep the direct row with matrices on the right and the reciprocal column with C on the left
alternatives_considered: normalize both cases to rows; normalize both to columns
supporting_rationale: the source deliberately changes orientation and star placement between the constructions
adverse_evidence: modern notation can tempt a silent transpose

decision: use restante representationes del classe and differente representationes de un classe
alternatives_considered: all representations; all classes
supporting_rationale: the source varies bases only within one fixed equivalence class
adverse_evidence: the theorem headline may otherwise be overread

decision: state explicitly that every form and grammar rule is a construction candidate with zero observations or pilot results
alternatives_considered: omit the boundary note
supporting_rationale: the access ledger contains no human data and cannot certify comprehension
adverse_evidence: the prose may look polished enough to be mistaken for a validated standard

decision: retain both teoria de Galois and de corps commutativ in the Chapter II title
alternatives_considered: shorten to teoria de Galois; broaden to all fields
supporting_rationale: the German title explicitly restricts the chapter framing to commutative fields
adverse_evidence: the prior introduction also mentioned noncommutative fields and could invite accidental carryover

decision: use two sentences while retaining that the representation theory already developed supplies the new foundation and that this foundation has the stated advantage
alternatives_considered: attach the advantage to representation theory in general; omit the back-reference
supporting_rationale: the German relative clause compares this foundation with the usual one
adverse_evidence: a pronoun-only rendering could make the advantage's antecedent unclear

decision: keep the source note attached to the introductory claim and preserve every M. Z. section number
alternatives_considered: move the note to an unlinked bibliography; omit the definition reference
supporting_rationale: the note supplies exact comparison and definition locators
adverse_evidence: reformatting can detach the §21 claim from the following Galois section

decision: render the proof as explicitly remaining undeveloped and do not invent proof steps
alternatives_considered: present the subsequent definitions as a proof; omit the reason
supporting_rationale: the source announces a theorem but says its proof shall remain unexecuted because it is nearly self-evident
adverse_evidence: the complete construction can look like an implicit proof if the omission is softened

decision: retain collection de tote le summas formal and omega_i in Omega before the rules
alternatives_considered: a generic span; an already evaluated sum
supporting_rationale: the source defines a formal coordinate set and later supplies coefficientwise equality
adverse_evidence: a span reading could presuppose relations not yet defined

decision: use si e solmente si and pro cata i inside the displayed equality rule
alternatives_considered: a one-way si; leave the index quantifier implicit
supporting_rationale: the source requires equality of every corresponding coefficient
adverse_evidence: a weakened connective or lost quantifier changes the formal object

decision: retain both left and right Omega actions and the final commutation equality then describe the module as connectite commutativmente con Omega
alternatives_considered: call Omega commutative; retain only one scalar action
supporting_rationale: the source assumes only that the center of Omega contains P and makes full commutativity a later conditional
adverse_evidence: the historical phrase is linguistically provisional and requires the formulas as its semantic control

decision: distinguish Omega as an anel de extension de P from o_Omega as scalar-extended system and later an anel de extension de o
alternatives_considered: use one undifferentiated extension label for all three roles
supporting_rationale: the source assigns different operands and logical stages to the extension relations
adverse_evidence: the shared word extension can obscure which inclusion or construction is meant

decision: copy the displayed multiplication exactly with the same i-indexed sum printed in both left factors and the double i j sum on the right
alternatives_considered: silently change the second left factor to a j-indexed sum; normalize dummy indices
supporting_rationale: the pinned authority prints the repeated left factor and user requires exact mathematical preservation
adverse_evidence: the source notation may look like a typographical shorthand or error but correction is not authorized

decision: render rango n super Omega as free-module rank controlled by the displayed c_i basis and keep basis independence separate from the final commutative-field condition
alternatives_considered: use matrix rank; state Omega is already commutative
supporting_rationale: the three source conclusions have distinct scopes and order
adverse_evidence: rango has ordinary-language and matrix-rank competitors

decision: state that all vocabulary and grammar forms remain provisional construction candidates with zero human native or pilot evidence
alternatives_considered: omit the boundary because the prose is polished
supporting_rationale: the v10 access ledger records zero human observations and no form promotions
adverse_evidence: internal source and mechanical QA cannot certify comprehension

decision: retain both representationes irreducibile and de sistems commutativ in the section heading
alternatives_considered: shorten to representationes; modernize systems to algebras
supporting_rationale: the source fixes both irreducibility and commutativity while preserving historical System terminology
adverse_evidence: modernization can silently strengthen the algebraic category

decision: render Omega as a corp de extension algebraicamente claudite of P
alternatives_considered: call Omega only commutative; reuse the earlier extension-ring condition
supporting_rationale: section 6 explicitly replaces the broader section 5 Omega hypothesis with an algebraically closed extension field
adverse_evidence: field and extension-ring wording are easy to conflate across adjacent sections

decision: mark the forward construction from Z to Z_Omega and the converse containment as distinct directions
alternatives_considered: collapse both to an assertion that the representation sets are identical
supporting_rationale: the source supplies a reason for each direction before allowing the reduced question
adverse_evidence: an equality claim would exceed the compact historical argument

decision: retain the compact clause about basis elements already contained in P without inventing a primitive element
alternatives_considered: resolve the historical wording into a modern primitive-element theorem
supporting_rationale: the source itself states only sufficiency for constructing the whole representation
adverse_evidence: the Chapter II introduction mentions generating systems and can invite an unsupported modernization

decision: keep the source's own definition that Z_Omega itself is used as representation module
alternatives_considered: use regular to mean nonsingular; omit the defining apposition
supporting_rationale: the apposition fixes the representation-theoretic sense locally
adverse_evidence: regular has ordinary and matrix senses that are adverse here

decision: use radical C and do not add Jacobson or nilradical
alternatives_considered: choose a modern subtype from context
supporting_rationale: the printed source names only das Radikal von Z_Omega
adverse_evidence: the likely historical interpretation does not authorize a silent subtype label

decision: preserve the inference fully reducible therefore direct sum of finite-degree fields then algebraic closure therefore Omega-isomorphic summands
alternatives_considered: compress directly to a product of copies of Omega
supporting_rationale: the source displays each logical stage and its reason
adverse_evidence: compression would conceal both finite degree and the algebraic-closure premise

decision: render Einheit as elemento identitate and bind it to T60-S1
alternatives_considered: render as unitate meaning arbitrary invertible element
supporting_rationale: the e_nu are components of the multiplicative identity in the displayed decomposition
adverse_evidence: T60-S4 is an adverse competing sense and must not be inherited

decision: preserve exactly t distinct irreducible representation classes all of degree one and t at most n
alternatives_considered: report t representations without classes; omit the upper bound
supporting_rationale: the source distinguishes classes then proves each class has one representation
adverse_evidence: the later singleton result must not be back-projected into the theorem statement

decision: preserve the degree-one commutative-field hypothesis and literal pi inverse alpha pi equals alpha
alternatives_considered: describe every representation class in every field as a singleton
supporting_rationale: the scalar conjugation argument is scoped to degree one in a commutative field
adverse_evidence: removing either hypothesis creates a false general claim

decision: preserve exactly t distinct homomorphic maps from Z_Omega onto subrings of Omega
alternatives_considered: upgrade maps to isomorphisms or automorphisms; make the codomain all of Omega
supporting_rationale: section 6 concludes only homomorphisms with subring images
adverse_evidence: section 7 later strengthens the restriction to Z and must remain separate

decision: use invariant le articles and invariant iste without plural istes plus mixed Romance morphology including cata; dunque; nam; claudite; summa; corp; subanellos
alternatives_considered: normalize the prose to standard Spanish or standard French; introduce a number-inflected demonstrative
supporting_rationale: the lane objective requires an actual controlled Romance candidate rather than softened ES or FR and the established demonstrative rule is invariant
adverse_evidence: number inflection in istes would contradict the reusable controlled-language contract while a polished standard-language surface would erase the experiment's anti-collapse discipline

decision: state zero human observations and no native pilot or marginal-intelligibility result
alternatives_considered: omit the boundary because source and build checks pass
supporting_rationale: the v10 access ledger contains no human observations and no form promotions
adverse_evidence: machine source fidelity cannot certify reader access
